latest.notes: Phone remote polish: the D-pad and Back are no longer stuck while a notification is showing, the first arrow press starts in the main content, the seek bar stays where you drop it, play/pause shows Buffering while the video is loading, and typed text with accents or emoji arrives intact.

versions.notes: Phone remote polish: the D-pad and Back are no longer stuck while a notification is showing, the first arrow press starts in the main content, the seek bar stays where you drop it, play/pause shows Buffering while the video is loading, and typed text with accents or emoji arrives intact.

The phone remote is redesigned in Arc TV's glass look and now controls the whole app. Move around and open titles with a round click-pad, play, pause and seek movies and shows (10 seconds back or forward), change volume and episodes, and search with your phone's keyboard. Scan the QR code in Settings → Remote control once to pair; old bookmarked links need a rescan.

Shows that your portal lists under Movies now open under Series from Search. Home's Live card opens your portal's Live TV, and Actor and Discover links stay on your Stalker portal. Includes 1.1.3: movies from Continue watching play.

Fix: movies opened from Continue watching on Home now play (Arc TV looks up the movie's playback details on your portal). Includes 1.1.2 and 1.1.1 fixes for series episodes, and 1.1.0: Stalker-only app, no Windows builds.

Fix: opening a show from Continue watching now loads its seasons and episodes (shows your portal lists inside its movie section). Includes 1.1.1 and 1.1.0 changes: Stalker-only app, no Windows builds.

Fixes: series that your portal lists inside its movie section now open with their seasons and episodes from the Series section, and category lists no longer show a meaningless dash pill. Also includes 1.1.0: Stalker-only app (Xtream and M3U removed) and no more Windows builds.

Arc TV for desktop now supports Stalker portals only. Xtream Codes and M3U playlists have been removed (existing sources stay in your data but are hidden), along with Windows builds. Fixes: series listed in a portal's movie section now appear under Series, and Continue watching on Home keeps every title you have started.

**Arc TV for Mac** 1.0.1 — Apple silicon (M1 and newer) and Intel.

**What's new:** Arc TV for Mac can now update itself. Open **Settings → About**, choose **Download**, then **Restart to
update**. Arc TV swaps itself for the new version and opens again, your playlists and settings are kept, and the old
version is put back automatically if anything goes wrong.

Arc TV has to be in your **Applications** folder to update itself.
